identifiers.identifier_scope: Ad-hCMV-TK is an investigational gene therapy agent.

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: Ad-hCMV-TK is a gene therapy that uses an adenoviral vector to deliver the herpes simplex virus thymidine kinase (HSV-TK) gene to cancer cells. Once inside the cells, the HSV-TK enzyme converts the prodrug ganciclovir into a toxic compound that kills the cancer cells.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Gene delivery of HSV-TK leading to conversion of ganciclovir into a cytotoxic agent.
downstream_effects: Induction of cell death in HSV-TK expressing cells

data_notes.record_scope: Ad-hCMV-TK is an investigational gene therapy primarily studied for glioblastoma.
